style.backgroundSystem: glazed square-tile walls in moss olive #6E7C3E with #4C5A2A grout lines for product and scene screens, flat pale pistachio-white #F3F6E9 and flat pure white #FFFFFF infographic pages, every page headed by an asymmetric deep-olive #6E7C3E pill banner
style.direction: moss-olive tile-grid herbal grooming commerce with metallic gold accents

style.lightingSystem: bright even studio lighting, large soft top-front key with a silver fill card, glossy wet highlights with crisp droplets on the product, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent moss-olive tile-grid herbal grooming visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale pistachio-white #F3F6E9, pure white #FFFFFF, moss olive #6E7C3E, deep olive text #33401C and one metallic gold accent #C9A94E; glazed square-tile walls with grout lines behind product shots and flat pale pages for infographics; bright even studio lighting with a large soft top-front key, glossy wet highlights and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines set inside asymmetric olive pill banners with a short uppercase eyebrow line and hairline rules; consistent solid olive ring badges, thick square photo frames and oversized pale-grey step numerals; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright or tilted product angle and scale with clean balanced composition; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no rounded corners replacing the square olive frames
no metallic gold outside the accent role
style.presentationRules: the product is shown upright and centred or tilted at one fixed angle with the cap leading the tilt, stable scale across the set, never clipped by the frame, always grounded by a soft contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: glazed ceramic tile #7C8B45, wet glazed ceramic counter #7C8B45, matte olive-green stone board #6E7C3E, neutral warm-grey macro board #E7E4DA and small brushed gold metal dishes and spatulas #C9A94E
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline in pale pistachio-white #F3F6E9 set inside asymmetric deep-olive #6E7C3E pill banners, with one short uppercase letterspaced eyebrow line, hairline #6E7C3E rules under every sub-heading, and oversized pale-grey #C9CCC0 outlined step numerals
